document: Hungarian tax return form or its summary (NAV form code, tax year, total tax)
glossary: Document type: Hungarian tax return form or its summary (NAV form code, tax year, total tax). Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.document_title: the document title as printed on the document (A bevallas cime/megnevezese, ahogy a folapon szerepel)
field_specs.form_code: the form code as printed on the document (Nyomtatvany-kod, pl. 17KATA, 21SZJA, 2153, 2353)
field_specs.tax_year: the tax year as printed on the document (Adoev, YYYY (pl. 2021))
field_specs.taxpayer_name: the taxpayer name as printed on the document (Adozo neve)
field_specs.tax_id: the tax id as printed on the document (Adoazonosito jel (10 szamjegy) VAGY adoszam, ahogy a folapon szerepel)
field_specs.issue_date: the issue date as printed on the document (Beadas/postara adas/keltezes datuma, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD)
field_specs.authority: the authority as printed on the document (Cimzett hatosag (pl. Nemzeti Ado- es Vamhivatal))
field_specs.total_tax: the total tax as printed on the document
